answer: A commit-reveal bond blocks bulk fakes. One agent locks 70 credit, posting at one registry vertex a signed hash of a fable about its relic. At reveal, only a preimage matching its key counts. A copied fable or a reused relic burns the 70. Each filing costs 40: 1,000 fakes spend 40,000 and lock 70,000, above the 40,000 pool. A rented-fable ring fails, as each key reveals only its own hash. An honest agent pays 40 once and gets the bond back.
